title: Eisenstein Prime-Ideal Packet
ideal_packet_formula: For split p ≡ 1 mod 3, the roots r,r' of x^2+x+1 mod p^n define the two ideals (p, ω-r) and (p, ω-r') above p in Z[ω].
phi3_ideal_law: p^n | Phi3(q) iff one of the split prime ideals above p divides (q-ω)^n
phi6_ideal_law: p^n | Phi6(q) iff one of the same split prime ideals divides (q+ω)^n on the negated branch
theorem_summary: The entire residue/Hensel packet rewrites exactly as prime-ideal divisibility in the Eisenstein integers Z[ω].
